role_in_parent: Provide the sharp global upper bound at rational endpoints and identify the unique endpoint achieving equality.
statement_nl: For every integer n>1 and every integer a with 0 <= a <= n-1, one has E_n(a/n) <= H_n - 1, and equality holds if and only if a = n-1.

domain_restrictions: n is an integer and n > 1
a is an integer and 0 <= a <= n - 1
the expression a/n is formed from an integer division into a rational number argument for E_n
statement_semantic_sketch.normalized_claim: For every integer n > 1 and every integer a with 0 <= a <= n - 1, the inequality E_n(a/n) <= H_n - 1 holds, and E_n(a/n) equals H_n - 1 if and only if a equals n - 1.
quantifier_order: for all integers n with n > 1
for all integers a with 0 <= a <= n - 1

variables.name: n
variables.role: outer parameter indexing the functions E_n and H_n

variables.name: a
variables.role: input index used to form the argument a/n

witness_dependencies: No existential witnesses are introduced; the equality condition is a direct constraint on the universally quantified variable a
The equality threshold H_n - 1 depends only on n, not on a, and the argument to E_n depends on both n and a through a/n
